card.title: IPad 10 not Reading Touch

claims.statement: iPad 10 no touch: first test a known-good digitizer and the two digitizer FPC connectors (pressing on them or bending a bowed connector edge back in can reveal/fix contact).
Board faults are usually a shorted cap around the two touch ICs, often on one specific filter's line; inject 1 V / 1 A to locate it.
Touch ICs are BCM15957A0, shared with iPad Air 4/5, iPad Pro 12.9 4th gen and iPad Pro 11 3rd/4th gen donors.

procedure: Remove the two shields; diode-check around touch ICs.
Inject 1 V / 1 A; remove hot cap or replace hot touch IC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
